`class GlslShaderTranslator`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`VulkanShaderTranslator`](/reference/vulkan/vulkanshadertranslator/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [GlslShaderTranslator.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/GlslShaderTranslator.java)

Rewrites the JOID GLSL stages of a shader into the dialect of a backend, with the declarations, uniforms and wrappers that JOID adds around the body.

## Description

A translator turns a vertex and fragment pair of [`ShaderSource`](/reference/pipeline/shadersource/) into complete sources for one [`GlslDialect`](/reference/pipeline/glsldialect/) and one [`UniformLayout`](/reference/pipeline/uniformlayout/), with the body numbered from line 1.
A backend passes one to the constructor of [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/), which translates both stages once; it extends this class when its compiler expects other declarations, as Vulkan adds `binding` and `location` qualifiers.
A stage that uses a [`ShaderFeature`](/reference/pipeline/shaderfeature/) the dialect lacks throws `UnsupportedOperationException` with the feature and the version it needs.

- [Shader translation](/build/shader-translation/#what-the-translator-adds)
- [Writing a backend](/build/writing-a-backend/)

## Creation details

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constructor"></a>

### GlslShaderTranslator

`GlslShaderTranslator(GlslDialect dialect, UniformLayout layout)` 

Creates a translator for a dialect and a uniform layout.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when the layout is `BLOCK` and the dialect has no uniform blocks.

## Property details

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-property-clampToBorder"></a>

### clampToBorder

- `this clampToBorder(boolean clampToBorder)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `boolean isClampToBorder()` 

**Default:** 

If `true`, each `texture(sampler, ...)` call samples through a function driven by the `vec3` uniform `joid_Border_<sampler>`, which returns transparent black outside the texture for a sampler in `CLAMP_TO_BORDER` mode, with an edge that fades over half a texel for a `LINEAR` filter.
The constructor of [`Shader`](/reference/bridges/shader/) turns it on when the render bridge cannot wrap to `CLAMP_TO_BORDER`.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-property-stencil"></a>

### stencil

- `this stencil(StencilEmulation.Pass stencil)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `StencilEmulation.Pass getStencil()` 

**Default:** `StencilEmulation.Pass.NONE`

Stencil emulation of the fragment stage: `NONE` adds nothing, `TEST` discards the fragments that fail the stencil comparison, `WRITE` outputs the updated stencil value instead of a color.
Any value but `NONE` declares the stencil uniforms and sampler, adds the `WRITE` stage to `translate`, and needs GLSL 1.30 or ESSL 3.00.

## Method details

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-translateVertex"></a>

### translateVertex

`String translateVertex(ShaderSource vertex, ShaderSource fragment)` 

Returns the translated vertex stage.
It reads the fragment source too, so that both stages declare the same uniforms and the same varying locations.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-translateFragment"></a>

### translateFragment

`String translateFragment(ShaderSource vertex, ShaderSource fragment)` 

Returns the translated fragment stage, with the stencil emulation set by `stencil`.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-translate"></a>

### translate

`ShaderTranslation translate(ShaderSource vertex, ShaderSource fragment)` 

Translates both stages into a [`ShaderTranslation`](/reference/pipeline/shadertranslation/).
With a stencil emulation, the translation also carries the fragment stage of the `WRITE` pass; otherwise its stencil fragment is `null`.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-createBlock"></a>

### createBlock

`UniformBlock createBlock(ShaderSource vertex, ShaderSource fragment)` 

Returns the [`UniformBlock`](/reference/pipeline/uniformblock/) of the translated uniforms of both stages, with their std140 offsets.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-getUniforms"></a>

### getUniforms

`List<ShaderVariable> getUniforms(ShaderSource vertex, ShaderSource fragment)` 

Lists the uniforms of the translated program in block order: the built-in uniforms that a stage uses, the uniforms that JOID adds, then those of the vertex and the fragment stages, each name once.
The samplers are not in the list.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-getSamplers"></a>

### getSamplers

`List<ShaderVariable> getSamplers(ShaderSource vertex, ShaderSource fragment)` 

Lists the samplers of the vertex then the fragment stage, each name once, then `joid_Stencil` under a stencil emulation; a sampler takes the unit of its place in the list, from `1`.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-getDialect"></a>

### getDialect

`GlslDialect getDialect()` 

Returns the dialect that the translator writes.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-getLayout"></a>

### getLayout

`UniformLayout getLayout()` 

Returns the uniform layout of the translated program.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-getBlockLayout"></a>

### getBlockLayout

`String getBlockLayout()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that returns the qualifiers written in `layout(...)` before the uniform block: `std140` by default.
Override it to add a binding, as Vulkan does with `std140, binding = 0`.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-declareSampler"></a>

### declareSampler

`String declareSampler(ShaderVariable sampler, int unit)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that declares a sampler; `unit` is its texture unit, from `1`.
Override it to add a binding qualifier.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-declareAttribute"></a>

### declareAttribute

`String declareAttribute(ShaderBuiltin builtin, int location)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that declares a vertex attribute at its location from [`VertexAttribute`](/reference/pipeline/vertexattribute/): `layout(location = n) in` when the dialect has explicit locations, `in` or `attribute` otherwise.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-method-declareVarying"></a>

### declareVarying

`String declareVarying(ShaderVariable varying, int location, boolean output)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Hook that declares a varying: `output` is `true` in the vertex stage and `false` in the fragment stage, and `location` is the same in both stages.
Override it to add a location qualifier.

## Constant and field details

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-BLOCK"></a>

### BLOCK

`String BLOCK` 

Name of the uniform block that holds every uniform under `UniformLayout.BLOCK`.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-ALPHA_TEST"></a>

### ALPHA_TEST

`String ALPHA_TEST` 

Name of the `int` uniform that turns on the alpha test: when it is not `0`, the fragment stage discards the fragments whose alpha is at most `ALPHA_THRESHOLD`.
[`Shader.builtins`](/reference/bridges/shader/#Shader-method-builtins) writes it from the alpha cutoff of the render state.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-ALPHA_THRESHOLD"></a>

### ALPHA_THRESHOLD

`String ALPHA_THRESHOLD` 

Name of the `float` uniform that holds the alpha cutoff of the render state, written by [`Shader.builtins`](/reference/bridges/shader/#Shader-method-builtins).

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-STENCIL"></a>

### STENCIL

`String STENCIL` 

Name of the sampler that holds the stencil values, one byte in the red channel, read at the position of the fragment.
The backend binds it for the `TEST` and `WRITE` passes.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-STENCIL_TEST"></a>

### STENCIL_TEST

`String STENCIL_TEST` 

Name of the `int` uniform that turns on the stencil comparison of the `TEST` pass, written by [`StencilEmulation.write`](/reference/pipeline/stencilemulation/#StencilEmulation-method-write) with the other stencil uniforms.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-STENCIL_MASK"></a>

### STENCIL_MASK

`String STENCIL_MASK` 

Name of the `int` uniform that holds the mask applied to the reference and to the stored value before the comparison.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-STENCIL_FAIL"></a>

### STENCIL_FAIL

`String STENCIL_FAIL` 

Name of the `int` uniform that holds the operation of the `WRITE` pass when the comparison fails, as the ordinal of [`StencilOperation`](/reference/pipeline/stenciloperation/).

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-STENCIL_PASS"></a>

### STENCIL_PASS

`String STENCIL_PASS` 

Name of the `int` uniform that holds the operation of the `WRITE` pass when the comparison passes, as the ordinal of [`StencilOperation`](/reference/pipeline/stenciloperation/).

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-STENCIL_FUNCTION"></a>

### STENCIL_FUNCTION

`String STENCIL_FUNCTION` 

Name of the `int` uniform that holds the comparison, as the ordinal of [`StencilFunction`](/reference/pipeline/stencilfunction/).

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-STENCIL_REFERENCE"></a>

### STENCIL_REFERENCE

`String STENCIL_REFERENCE` 

Name of the `int` uniform that holds the reference of the comparison and of the `REPLACE` operation.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-LINE_WIDTH"></a>

### LINE_WIDTH

`String LINE_WIDTH` 

Name of the `float` uniform of a line shader that holds the line width of the render state, in screen pixels.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-LINE_VIEWPORT"></a>

### LINE_VIEWPORT

`String LINE_VIEWPORT` 

Name of the `vec2` uniform of a line shader that holds the size of the viewport in pixels, which turns the width of a line into clip space.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-VERTEX_COLOR"></a>

### VERTEX_COLOR

`String VERTEX_COLOR` 

Name of the `int` uniform that tells whether the vertex buffer carries colors: when it is `0`, every read of `aColor` gives `CURRENT_COLOR`.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-CURRENT_COLOR"></a>

### CURRENT_COLOR

`String CURRENT_COLOR` 

Name of the `vec4` uniform that holds the current color of the render state, for the vertices without a color.

<a id="GlslShaderTranslator-constant-BORDER"></a>

### BORDER

`String BORDER` 

Prefix of the `vec3` uniform of each sampler under `clampToBorder`, followed by the name of the sampler.
[`Shader.builtins`](/reference/bridges/shader/#Shader-method-builtins) writes the mode (`0` off, `1` nearest, `2` linear), then the width and the height of the texture.
